title: Arm reports Q2 revenue up 27% YoY to $1.44B, vs. $1.38B est., royalty revenue up 8% to $670M, vs. $720.8M est., and licensing revenue up 50% to $773M (Reuters)
summary: Reuters: Arm reports Q2 revenue up 27% YoY to $1.44B, vs. $1.38B est., royalty revenue up 8% to $670M, vs. $720.8M est., and licensing revenue up 50% to $773M — Arm Holdings (O9Ty.F), beat Wall Street estimates for second-quarter revenue on Wednesday, driven by higher royalty payments and licensing fees …
